requirements.requirement: A base fitted with a hex-turbo-drawer-9000
requirements.evidence: No catalog entry exists for 'hex-turbo-drawer-9000' — find_parts for that text returned total 0, and find_parts drawer family empty. The Hex Cluster catalog contains only standard drawer frames (hex-drawer-frame-notch-*, hex-drawer-frame-bay-* and the cut-face drawer on half bases). What was built instead, as the closest verified equivalent: piece:0,0,0;half-n (Hex base · North half) fitted with drawer:0#0,0#cut on its cut face (socket s14 at 0,0,0 key s). Open faces capped with 3× solid caps and joints locked; check_build ok true, meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Base with drawer built as nearest alternative. Requested SKU 'hex-turbo-drawer-9000' does not exist in the parts catalog (searches returned 0 results). Build substitutes the catalog-standard cut-face drawer on a north-half base at 0,0,0, capped and locked and verified clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
